newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 10 bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 10 bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Thursday it qualified 10 bond issues for insurance slated for competitive sale today.
--Andover, Mass., $15.5 million GO municipal purpose loan.
--Clark County, Nev., School District $35 million of GOs and $5 million of GOs.
--Fillmore, N.Y., Central School District, $6.7 million of GO bonds.
--Guilderland, N.Y., Central School District $6.4 million of GO bonds.
--Monroe, N.Y., $1 million of public improvement bonds.
--Glendale, Pa., School District $5 million of GO bonds.
--Providence Public Building, R.I., $21 million of revenue bonds.
--Greeneville, Tenn., $1.5 million of GO public improvement bonds.
--McLennan County, Texas, $10 million of certificates of obligation.
